blocks.text: You can edit, delete, enable, or disable the ignore alert filters that you've added.
Editing or deleting the ignore alert filters impact only the newly triggered alerts.
To edit an ignore alert filter:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Policy Exceptions.
The Ignore Alert Filter page appears.
On the Ignore Alert Filter page, locate the ignore alert filter you want to edit.
Click the Actions icon () and select Edit.
See image.
The Edit Ignore Filter page appears.
On the Edit Ignore Filter page, in the General Information section, change the Ignore Filter Name or Filter Description as required, then click Next.
In the Filter Scope section, update the filters as required, then click Next.
Review the changes and click Finish.
See image.
A message appears indicating that the ignore alert filter is updated successfully.

blocks.text: To delete an ignore alert filter:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Policy Exceptions.
The Ignore Alert Filter page appears.
On the Ignore Alert Filter page, locate the ignore alert filter you want to delete.
Click the Actions icon () and select Delete.
See image.
A confirmation message appears. Read the message and click Delete.
See image.
The ignore alert filter is deleted from the Zscaler Admin Console and is no longer available in the ignore alerts table.

blocks.heading: Enabling or Disabling Ignore Alert Filter

blocks.text: You can enable or disable the ignore alert filters you've added.

By default, the ignore alert filter is enabled. If the selected filters of the filter scope are deleted (e.g., policies are deleted, accounts are offboarded, or the business unit is deleted), the ignore alert filter is disabled. You can enable the filter only after the filter scope is updated.
To enable or disable the ignore alert filter:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Policy Exceptions.
The Ignore Alert Filter page appears.
On the Ignore Alert Filter page, click the toggle under the State column to enable or disable the ignore alert filter.
See image.
A confirmation message appears indicating that the ignore alert filter is going to be enabled or disabled. Click Enable or Disable depending on the action.
See image.
